review_comments: It's a bit complex as `failpoints` in schema diff loader is needed.
I'm a little confused about this name.

`amendTS` is the first `commitTS` which is used to do the amend work, after amend we will take another `newCommitTS` to commit the transaction, the `c.commitTS` will be set to the `newCommitTS` after the second time schema check succeed.
Yes, I know it. It's better to add more words.
